parameters.apprise_url_plus: sparkpost://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.user_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.host_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.apikey_secret }} }
parameters.description:
Send an email to your own SparkPost destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-sparkpost-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your SparkPost destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional SparkPost destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SparkPost destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to SparkPost transmissions API

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SparkPost Email apikey

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SparkPost Email host

user_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SparkPost Email user
